name: shutdown
description: Bulk shutdown all guests on the cluster.

params.name: force-stop
params.description: Makes sure the Guest stops after the timeout.

params.name: max-workers
params.description: Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently.

params.name: maxworkers
params.description: Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently. Deprecated, use 'max-workers' instead.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Default shutdown timeout in seconds if none is configured for the guest.

params.name: vms
params.description: Only consider guests from this list of VMIDs.

permissions.description: The 'VM.PowerMgmt' permission is required on '/' or on '/vms/<ID>' for each ID passed via the 'vms' parameter.
